label: Rematch — the eleventh storm
location: The highland pass, above the road

recentEvents.value: The Continuance returned it to the thermals; it counts his returns like storms in a season.
Eleventh storm out of a clear sky. The road is still behind him — and he still takes the uphill one.

unresolvedConflicts.value: Weather that keeps coming back against the wind.

temporaryObjective.value: Turn him again. The road is a trust: whoever walks it arrives — even back at his own gate.
